'''Umiam Gorelox''' was a [[professor]] of<ref name="A Lot to Learn" /> the [[Muun]] [[homeworld]]<ref name="Endless Vigil">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref> [[Scipio]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Gorelox had a reservation at the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]]<ref name="A Lot to Learn" /> in [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> but was impersonated by the [[human]] criminal [[Jod Na Nawood]], attempting to infiltrate the spa with four [[Youngling|children]]. After Nawood learned that Gorelox represented Scipio upon being questioned on his supposed identity by a security guard, he attempted to flee.<ref name="A Lot to Learn" />
